column5: GROUP: **optimization-unit (9)** | 81. `OU/observation.rs:230-235` live-out detection ignores `structural_bindings` and ownership events.
GROUP: **optimization-unit (9)** | 82. `OU/rewrite.rs:2618-2629` the constant-replacement arm checks provenance only, not the witness kind.
GROUP: **optimization-unit (9)** | 83. `OU/structural_places.rs:1025-1034` a zeroed value is taken to be in the first declared case without verifying that zero inhabits it.
GROUP: **abstract-operations (2)** | 84. `AO/operations.rs:946`, `AO/operations.rs:1075` new variants default to "no structural result" and "no paths".

GROUP: **abstract-operations (2)** | 85. `AO/storage_mutations.rs:84` `ReleaseReference`, `PortWrite`, `RegisterAccess`, `GlobalDescriptorTable`, `ActivateTaskRegister` are treated as mutating nothing.
GROUP: **machine-code (4)** | 86. `MC/encoding.rs:152-161` `bytes()` returns `&[]` for an out-of-range span; an `Encoded` row with a corrupt span hashes as zero bytes.
GROUP: **machine-code (4)** | 87. `MC/lib.rs:288, 298` `PlacedImageAddress` accessors return `None` for other reference kinds; callers not traced.

GROUP: **machine-code (4)** | 88. `MC/layout.rs:326-332` the layout identity does not hash `normalized_foreign_call_fixup`. Wrong artifact: a value whose fixup differs but whose other hashed fields match has the same identity.
